topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I just found out someone got a tattoo of my artwork. They really captured the essence of the piece; the lines are crisp, and the shading deep, much like I had envisioned when I first put pen to paper. It’s a strange sensation, knowing that my vision now adorns someone's skin, becoming a part of them. It's a testament to the impact art can have, how it can resonate so deeply that someone would choose to carry it with them forever. I'm eager to reach out and thank them for choosing my work to immortalize in ink.
